title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 146
description: Ten questions on Psalms 146: why not to trust princes, and the God of Jacob who frees prisoners and upholds the fatherless and widow.

questions.text: How long does the psalmist say he will praise Yahweh?
questions.explanation: He says, "While I live, I will praise Yahweh. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist."

answers.text: While he lives, as long as he exists
Until the new song is finished

questions.text: In whom should people not put their trust?
questions.explanation: The psalm warns, "Don't put your trust in princes, in a son of man in whom there is no help."

answers.text: Princes, a son of man in whom there is no help
Horses and chariots gathered for the battle
Riches and the fine gold of the merchants
Idols of silver made by the hands of men

questions.text: What happens to a man's thoughts on the day his spirit departs?
questions.explanation: When his spirit departs, he returns to the earth, and in that very day his thoughts perish.

answers.text: They are written in a book

questions.text: Who is called happy in verse 5?
questions.explanation: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in Yahweh, his God.

answers.text: He who has the God of Jacob for his help
He who dwells in God's house

questions.text: What did the God of Jacob make, according to verse 6?
questions.explanation: He is the one who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them, who keeps truth forever.

answers.text: The sun and the moon to rule over day and night
Man from the dust of the ground in his image
Heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them
The mountains and all the deep places of the earth

questions.text: What does Yahweh do for the prisoners?
questions.explanation: The psalm says Yahweh executes justice for the oppressed, gives food to the hungry, and frees the prisoners.
The psalm says, "Yahweh opens the eyes of the blind."

questions.text: Who does Yahweh uphold, according to verse 9?
questions.explanation: Yahweh preserves the foreigners and upholds the fatherless and widow.

questions.text: What does Yahweh do to the way of the wicked?
questions.explanation: The psalm says he turns the way of the wicked upside down.

answers.text: He makes it slippery in darkness
He shortens it to the grave

questions.text: How long will Yahweh reign, according to the last verse?
questions.explanation: The psalm ends, "Yahweh will reign forever; your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise Yah!"

answers.text: As long as the sun endures
